note: Stamped after the fact for IBM rows already committed. The scenario digest and malariasimulation version are computed from the current checkout; the date is when the stamp was made, not when every row was generated. run_replicates.R writes this file itself from now on. The digest was re-stamped on 2026-09-11 when scenario_digest() was changed to hash text rather than a serialised R object: the old value fingerprinted the machine (R version, platform, digest's serializeVersion) as much as the scenarios, so it could never match in CI. The scenarios themselves did not change, and the IBM rows are untouched.
